name: Sensitivity Table
summary: Two-way sensitivity grid (e.g. DCF value vs WACC × terminal growth, LBO IRR vs entry × exit multiple) with diverging heat around the base case.
summary_zh: 双变量敏感性分析表（如 DCF 股价对 WACC × 永续增长率、LBO IRR 对进入 × 退出倍数），以基准情形为中点的发散色热力。
description_zh: 估值与 LBO 页的标准表格：长表数据（row、col、value 三列）自动转成二维网格，行列表头按字段格式显示（如 7.5% / 2.0%、8.0x），基准单元格加框，颜色按与基准（或 mid 指定的门槛，如 20% IRR）的偏离深浅着色。悬停出现行列十字高亮和含“较基准变化”的提示框，可切换显示绝对值 / 与基准差值 / 百分比变化；点击单元格可把它设为新的基准，若 base 绑定 @参数（如 @wacc）则同步更新全局参数。
best_for: DCF implied share price vs WACC × terminal growth
LBO IRR / MoM vs entry × exit multiple
Accretion / dilution vs offer price × stock mix
avoid_when: One-dimensional sensitivities (use a tornado / bar chart)

value.desc: Output for each row × column pair

base.desc: {row, col} base-case driver values, or '@param' names (e.g. {"row": "@wacc", "col": "@tgr"}); null = middle cell

rowTitle.desc: Row axis title (defaults to the row field title)

colTitle.desc: Column axis title (defaults to the col field title)

rowFormat.desc: Row header format (defaults to the row field format, e.g. 0.0%)

colFormat.desc: Column header format (defaults to the col field format)

format.desc: Cell format (defaults to the value field format)

deltaFormat.desc: Format in Δ mode (defaults to '+fmt;(fmt);fmt' of the cell format: negatives in parentheses)

mid.desc: Midpoint of the diverging scale; defaults to the base value (e.g. 0.20 for an IRR hurdle)

reverse.desc: Flip colours when lower values are better

heatIntensity.desc: 0–1 span of the theme ramp used (0.5 ≈ div-2…div-6 / seq-2…seq-6); text colour is picked for 4.5:1 contrast

mode.desc: value | delta | pct — initial display mode

toggle.desc: Show the Value / Δ vs base / % vs base switch

caption.desc: Show the 'Base case: … = …' line above the grid

crosshair.desc: Highlight the hovered row and column

tooltip.desc: Hover tooltip with value and change vs base

rebase.desc: Click a cell to make it the base case (sets the bound @params)

rowOrder.desc: asc | desc order of row drivers

colOrder.desc: asc | desc order of column drivers

interactions: Click a cell to re-base (drives @params when bound)

samples.title: LBO — sponsor IRR vs entry / exit multiple
DCF — change vs base case (print style, no heat)
